notes.title: Easy Mode is hopefully Easy now!
notes.content:
update: Early skill choices push for new spells over passives and upgrades
update: Passives are less frequent choices to allow for more powerful upgrade
update: A new spell should always be available when slots are free
fix: Using the Escape menu too quickly breaks the mouse in-game
update: Easy mode has been updated drastically to actually be easy - enemies have less health and do less damage
update: Players will no longer damage their pillar
update: The Novice Tower map no longer has pits but the rails on the side have been removed for fun knockback potential
add: Archers have a new cowl! They should be much more noticeable as a target
add: New Auto-Aim assist for the bolts has been added - you can find it in the Escape menu to increase or decrease it's effect
add: Bolts have a small lob effect to properly track downstairs and have less stray shots
update: Spell slot selection will indicate which spell you're adding
add: New damage effect to the edges of the screen that will progressively increase as your hit points run low
add: New health drops! Depending on the difficulty they'll drop more or less with a bit of randomness
